description: Source code for the AppActor class in the Thingsboard server, responsible for managing tenant actors, processing system messages, and handling component lifecycle events within the actor system.

classes.name: AppActor
classes.description: Main actor class managing tenant actors and processing system messages within the Thingsboard server.

classes.name: AppActor.ActorCreator
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of AppActor with specific actor IDs.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the actor, scheduling periodic session timeout checks if applicable.

methods.name: doProcess
methods.description: Processes incoming messages based on their type, handling system initialization, tenant management, and message forwarding.

methods.name: initTenantActors
methods.description: Creates tenant actors for all tenants if tenant component initialization is enabled.

methods.name: onQueueToRuleEngineMsg
methods.description: Handles messages directed to the rule engine, routing them to the appropriate tenant actor.

methods.name: onComponentLifecycleMsg
methods.description: Handles component lifecycle events, such as tenant deletion and component updates.

methods.name: forwardToTenantActor
methods.description: Forwards messages to tenant actors, with optional high priority.

methods.name: getOrCreateTenantActor
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a tenant actor reference, considering deleted tenants.

methods.name: onProcessFailure
methods.description: Handles failures during message processing, logging errors.

methods.name: createActorId
methods.description: Creates a unique actor ID for the system tenant.
